calibration_method: W5-W6 fit / W7-W8 untouched diagnostic using today's line as threshold; not historical market line validation; correction applied only with >=30 fit and test rows, positive slope, and lower Brier plus log loss.
limitations: Player-game export cannot distinguish a healthy active zero-opportunity game from an inactive game; positive-opportunity conditioning retains zero stat outcomes when opportunity exists.
Opponent adjustment is exploratory and capped at 0.75-1.25; no coverage/assignment/route/pressure decision-time data enter these draws.
These are empirical bootstrap frequencies, not independently calibrated prop-hit probabilities.
Quote times are per-book source and receipt timestamps; quotes expire at validUntil and must be rechecked after that time.
